title: Regional Sales Manage – Mobile Division
description:
Job Description – **Regional Sales Manager (Mobile Division)**

**Company:** Sanket India  
**Department:** Sales

Job Summary

Sanket India is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager to manage mobile business operations across multiple stores and locations. The candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, managing teams, coordinating with mobile brands, and ensuring business performance across all assigned stores.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage mobile sales operations across multiple stores and locations.
* Achieve sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability.
* Monitor store-wise sales performance and team productivity.
* Coordinate with mobile brands, distributors, and promoters for stock, schemes, and promotional activities.
* Ensure product availability, pricing, display, and visibility across stores.
* Lead, train, and motivate store sales teams to achieve targets.
* Analyze sales reports, market trends, competitor activities, and new product launches.
* Coordinate with inventory, marketing, and operations teams to improve business performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline preferred.
* Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in mobile sales or retail management.
* Proven experience managing **multiple stores across different locations**.
* Strong knowledge of mobile brands, products, pricing, and market trends.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and sales reporting.

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:

**Email:** hrm@sanketgroup.com  
**Contact:** 99789 97324

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Leader | Java | Next.Js
description:
What you'll do

* Own end-to-end delivery of a multi-module platform (React/Next.js frontend, Java/Spring Boot backend)
* Break the product into modules, epics and stories; sequence work across them and manage dependencies
* Set and guard the architecture — shared services, data models, APIs between modules, multi-tenant concerns
* Run sprints in Jira; track velocity, scope and risk; keep the release plan realistic
* Review code, enforce standards, and unblock developers daily
* Be the primary technical point of contact for the client — demos, status updates, change requests
* Own release planning and deployments with DevOps (AWS, Docker, CI/CD)
* Mentor and grow a team of 4–8 developers; run 1:1s and performance feedback
* Maintain technical documentation, module specs and delivery reports

Must have

* 6–8 years in software development, with 2+ years leading a team on a long-running product
* Strong hands-on background in React/Next.js and Java/Spring Boot (or close equivalent)
* Experience shipping a large modular system — not just small isolated projects
* Solid grasp of Agile/Scrum, estimation and dependency management
* Cloud and deployment familiarity (AWS, Docker, CI/CD)
* Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable presenting to international clients
* Calm under deadline pressure; decisive with incomplete information

Nice to have

* Multi-tenant SaaS architecture experience
* Domain-driven design, event-driven or microservice patterns
* Mobile module delivery (Flutter/React Native, App Store/Play Store cycles)
* Prior experience taking a product from MVP to v2+
* Pre-sales exposure: scoping, proposals, effort estimation

What we offer

* Full ownership of one product and its client relationship, not context-switching across accounts
* Say in hiring, tooling and process
* Learning budget and flexible hours
* Competitive salary

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Flutter Developer
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **1 Year experienced required**
* Develop and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter** and **Dart**.
* Implement **state management** solutions (GetX preferred).
* Build **responsive UIs** that adapt to multiple screen sizes and devices.
* Integrate and manage **RESTful APIs** with JSON parsing and efficient network handling.
* Publish and update applications on the **Google Play Store** and **Apple App Store**.

* Implement and manage **push notifications** (Firebase Cloud Messaging & local notifications).

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in **Dart programming fundamentals** (loops, conditionals, syntax).
* Solid experience with **Flutter framework** for cross-platform development.
* Hands-on experience in **publishing apps** to Google Play and App Store.
* Familiarity with **mobile app lifecycle, performance optimization, and debugging**.
* Understanding of **state management techniques**, preferably GetX.
* Knowledge of **REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure data handling**.
* Strong grasp of **design patterns** and clean architecture principles.
* Ability to **write testable code** and perform unit/widget testing.
* Familiarity with **native Android & iOS workflows and integrations**.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

title: Android Developer
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Android Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Android development, coupled with expertise in modern technologies, especially Jetpack Compose, and architectural patterns. If you are passionate about crafting high-quality mobile apps and staying updated with the latest trends, we would love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Android applications using **Jetpack Compose**.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
* Utilize Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVP) to write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
* Stay up to date with Google's recommendations and the latest Android development trends.
* Debug and resolve technical issues using strong debugging skills and tools like ADB commands.
* Implement app-to-app communication channels and ensure seamless user experience.
* Work with relational databases like MySQL and Android-specific databases such as Room or Realm.
* Ensure robust application performance and security by adhering to best practices.
* Collaborate on API testing and validation using tools like Postman.
* Participate in continuous integration and deployment processes using tools such as Jenkins.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in mobile app development.
* Proficiency in Native Android development with a strong portfolio of mobile apps.
* **Strong Kotlin programming skills and mandatory experience with Jetpack Compose.**
* Familiarity with dependency injection frameworks like Dagger 2 or Hilt.
* Working knowledge of RxJava for asynchronous programming.
* Strong problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git or Bitbucket.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience integrating payment gateways.
* Knowledge of eCommerce domain and related technologies.
* Exposure to React Native is an added advantage.

title: Android Developer
description:
Android Developer

**Experience:** 2+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Software Development

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Android Developer with 2+ years of experience in developing and maintaining Android applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Kotlin and Java, a good understanding of Android architecture, and the ability to build high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Android applications using Kotlin and Java.
* Work with Android SDK, Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.
* Implement application architecture using MVVM or MVP patterns.
* Integrate REST APIs and manage local data using SQLite and Room Database.
* Implement Firebase services and push notification functionality.
* Identify, debug, and resolve application issues to ensure optimal performance.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UI/UX designers, developers, and QA engineers.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and Agile development activities.
* Ensure application quality, usability, performance, and compatibility across Android devices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 2+ years of professional experience in Android development.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
* Hands-on experience with Android SDK and Jetpack libraries.
* Good understanding of MVVM/MVP architecture and design patterns.
* Experience with REST API integration, SQLite, and Room Database.
* Knowledge of Git for version control.
* Experience with Firebase and push notifications.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of clean code principles and mobile UI/UX best practices.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment.

Preferred Qualities

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to code quality.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Android developer
description:
###### **Code the next innings of CricHeroes on Android.**
Cricket connects millions, and CricHeroes brings that connection to life through technology.


Our Android app is where cricketers record matches, track stats, and celebrate their performances. With millions of downloads, it’s already making waves, but we’re just getting started.


That’s where you come in.


###### **The challenge**
We’re looking for an Android Developer who’s passionate about building high performance apps and learning fast.


You’ll work with our product and engineering teams to create smooth, scalable, and intuitive experiences that bring grassroots cricket closer to the digital world.


###### **Your mission?**
Turn everyday matches into unforgettable experiences, powered by clean code and creative problem solving.


###### **What we’re looking for**


* Fresher with a strong interest in Android development.
* Strong knowledge of Kotlin. Java familiarity is a plus.
* Hands on experience with Android Studio, XML layouts, and Material Design guidelines.
* Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, and SQLite data storage mechanisms.
* Familiarity with MVVM architecture, Jetpack Components, and version control tools like Git.
* Curiosity to explore new technologies and experiment with modern Android libraries.

A team player who values clean, readable, and maintainable code.  
* 

###### **What you’ll do**


* Collaborate with designers and backend developers to build new features for the CricHeroes Android app.
* Write efficient, testable, and reusable Kotlin code.
* Debug issues, optimize performance, and ensure app stability across devices.
* Participate in code reviews and continuously learn from the team.

Contribute ideas to improve user experience and app quality.  
* 

###### **About CricHeroes**
CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network with 50\+ million users worldwide. We help local cricketers showcase their talent, get recognition, and improve their game using data and technology.


We believe in fewer rules, more ownership, and loads of candour. You’ll join a young, collaborative team that loves building products that make grassroots cricket unforgettable.


If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you.


If this sounds like your kind of challenge then\-


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in
